title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy's Astonishing Burst
items.text: Rory McIlroy fired 11-under over 10 holes during the BMW PGA Championship pro-am, stunning a commentator and signaling a return to form ahead of the Ryder Cup.

items.headline: Tiger Woods' Possible Return
items.text: Tiger Woods hit balls publicly for the first time since his 2026 car crash but faces new 2028 PGA Tour eligibility rules and a five-year driving ban that may limit his competitive comeback.

items.headline: McIlroy Predicts LIV Exodus
items.text: Rory McIlroy expects LIV Golf's bankruptcy to cause top players to leave, benefiting the DP World Tour with an influx of elite talent.
